claude.sample_unit: participants (English-speaking US women with at least one prior mammogram)

links.outcome: Intent to consult an attorney for litigation and follow-up behaviors when AI performance metrics (FDR/FOR) were shown
links.effect: Litigation intent was higher when AI was included, especially when AI suggested cancer. Adding FDR/FOR reduced litigation, with similar effects on follow-up behaviors.
links.quote: Providing the FDR/FOR reduced litigation; similar effects were observed for follow-up behaviors.

screen.practice: AI transparency and performance metric disclosure in patient portals
screen.reason: The study empirically tests how different ways of communicating AI mammography results (e.g., disclosure of AI reports, threshold information, and FDR/FOR metrics) to patients in portals impact follow-up decisions, trust, and litigation intent.
